Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Trial runway — connector cascade blocking our QA

Hi Priyom / Marissa,

Quick note from our engineering team — after the last config push yesterday we started seeing a cascade of connector timeouts when validating against our staging data. The team is deep on a fix but it looks like it will be at least a week before we can finish the adapter rework and run the regression suite.

We were planning to go live at the end of next week but with this block we’re worried the current trial window (expires 10/19) won’t be enough to finish the validation. Can you help us with a short runway extension (7–10 days) and a small sandbox top-up? I attached the truncated error log and a screenshot of the queue backpressure.

Details:
- Account: TechBridge (deal DB-3491)
- Affected connector: PaymentRail (internal adapter)
- Impact: staging tests consistently fail, blocking demo to stakeholders

Appreciate any help — happy to jump on a quick call if that helps triage.

Thanks,
Amit Rao
Senior Platform Engineer, TechBridge
